newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr strengthens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr strengthens against dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr firmed against the dollar on Monday, the central bank said.
The central National Bank of Ethiopia posted the birr at a mean rate of 6.38 compared to 6.41 last week.
After a currency auction on November 23, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the period November 25 to December 1 would be 6.38 to the dollar, the bank said.

The bank also quoted the birr against the pound at a mean rate of 10.7534 from 10.7944 last week. On the yen, the birr was traded at 0.057358 from 0.057493 and at 4.2584 against the mark from 4.2810 last week.
